title: Fix the off-by-one in range()

brief.goal: range(start, end) in src/range.ts must return the integers from start up to but not including end; the existing test in test/range.test.ts currently fails.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

expected_clean_output: Loop condition changed from <= to <; the existing test and the grader pass.

seeded_defect.description: Over-corrected: the loop stops at end - 1, so range(5, 6) returns [] and range(0, 3) returns [0, 1].
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Run test/range.test.ts or the grader: range(0, 3) is [0, 1].
